text: The NASA life-support baseline assigns lettuce a 28-day growth period.
Mars reaches northern autumn at solar longitude 180°. This begins dust storm season.
NASA’s orbital data identified areas on Mars with ice less than 30 centimeters underground.
Curiosity measured about 0.67 mSv/day at Gale. Dose raises allele-flip chance in crosses. Alleles themselves are game rules.
NASA’s life-support baseline budgets about 0.8 kg dry food solids per crew member per day.
Phoenix measured about 0.4–0.6 wt% perchlorate in Vastitas Borealis soil, with alkaline pH near 7.7.
Curiosity found perchlorate salts in the Rocknest scoop at Gale Crater.
A Mars sol lasts about 24 hours 39 minutes 35 seconds—longer than an Earth day.
InSight lost nearly all of its usable solar power to dust accumulation before the mission ended.
During the 2018 global dust storm, Opportunity measured optical depth near 10.8 before contact was lost.
NASA’s Veggie system on the ISS grows salad crops to study food production for crews living off Earth.
Average Mars surface pressure is only about 6–7 mbar—less than one percent of Earth’s sea-level pressure.
